g.text: Sequence Diagram - BCK10 Replace the Product Default Composition
SELECT Product and composition FOR UPDATE
[Product does not exist or is not a configured Predefined Pizza]
[Product is configured as a Predefined Pizza]
Read component eligibility, type rules and eligible sizes
UPDATE Product and replace composition items
The Product row is locked before validation and replacement. The Product and
composition changes share one transaction; failure rolls back and preserves
the previous composition. The replacement must cover at least one active size.
BCK10 rejects a component list containing the representative ProductId before
opening the transaction. BCK10 does not check stock or modify BCK08 data.
